label: Choice list
description: A reusable, ordered list of options for single_select, multi_select, status, and priority fields. Each option has a stable ID that records store, a label people see, an optional tone token for badges, and a hidden flag for retiring options without losing data.
usage: Reuse one list for every field with the same meaning.
Use lowercase IDs that describe the option (network), and relabel rather than rename.
Assign tones only where color helps scanning (priorities, states).
constraints: Option IDs are unique within the list, stable, and never reused; renaming an ID would orphan stored values.
tone must be a design token (accent.red, accent.amber, ...), never a raw color.
Retire options with hidden: true; they stay valid on existing records but cannot be newly selected.
A list holds at most 100 options; order is display and sort order.
